name: The █████ or global █████ collapse
source:
Sometimes everything changes even before you get out of bed.
- ███████
‘Your favourite words are now banned!’ shouts an angry politician from the TV screen. The world has suddenly become far too formal. Which means someone has clearly gone too far. It’s time to find out who stole the words and put everything back in its place.

A humorous visual novel about censorship, absurdity and the sacred right to say something silly.

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/topic-223504963_55802755]VK[/url]]
translation:
有时，甚至在你起床之前，一切都会发生变化。
- ███████
“你最喜欢的词现在被禁止了！”一位愤怒的政客在电视屏幕上喊道。世界突然变得太正式了。这意味着有人显然走得太远了。是时候找出是谁偷了这些话，并将所有东西放回原位。

一部关于审查制度、荒谬和说傻话的神圣权利的幽默视觉小说。

[译自[url=https://vk.com/topic-223504963_55802755]VK[/url]]
